title: Authologic vs IDnow | Identity verification comparison
summary: Authologic vs IDnow: eID-first identity infrastructure vs video, automated and German eID identification, compared on eIDs, EUDI Wallet and QES.
body_markdown:
*eID-first identity infrastructure compared with video, automated and German eID identification with qualified signatures.*


Authologic and IDnow both serve regulated businesses in Europe but start from different methods. Authologic leads with eIDs, bank IDs and digital identity wallets across 140+ identity methods and falls back to document and selfie checks. IDnow offers video identification, automated document verification, the German eID and qualified electronic signatures. Authologic fits multi-market eID-first onboarding; IDnow fits businesses that need video identification or qualified signing in one flow.
